decisions.reason: As a niche but complementary automation module in a broad precast portfolio, it has survived its first review and still carries option value while evidence on demand continues to build.
The stand-alone shuttering robot remains a credible modular offer for customers adopting automation step by step, so keeping it open is more valuable than abandoning it now.
Because this 2024 multi-model product line is very new and fits the firm's integrated plant workflow, uncertainty is still high and the firm would usually allow more time before exiting.

The production analysis software is close to the firm's existing controls and service capabilities, likely inexpensive to keep available, and strategically useful for deepening lifecycle support and future automation sales.
